subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers adopt or refresh one of the existing Feishu URL-boundary candidate fixes, or authorize a fresh same-repository fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug is narrow and valid, but existing no-new-fix-pr/linked-pr-open state plus several closed/conflicting candidate branches make the next step an ownership and routing choice rather than a safe automatic new branch.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
options.body: Close or preserve prior attempts as context, then land one narrow Feishu plugin fix with focused tests and live Feishu proof.

options.title: Refresh one prior candidate
options.body: Pick the best prior branch, resolve drift, and require the same regression coverage plus live behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor follow-up
options.body: Keep this issue open without new automation until a contributor updates a candidate branch with mergeable code and proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
recommendation.body: Close or preserve prior attempts as context, then land one narrow Feishu plugin fix with focused tests and live Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu send/outbound history makes this the strongest available owner for choosing the repair path.
